description: GTFS réseau Cmonbus is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CA Luberon Monts de Vaucluse. Theoretical transport offer of the Cmonbus bus network of the agglomeration community Luberon Monts de Vaucluse (CA LMV) on the municipalities of Cavaillon, Robion and the Taillades. network composed of 5 urban lines, 1 shuttle P+R, a village shuttle and 4 school services. Coverage: CA Luberon Monts de Vaucluse. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS Cmonbus Network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CA Luberon Monts de Vaucluse. Its keywords include mobilite-transport. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GTFS-RT, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
